title: Final Force Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state the final expression for the force dF = (1/2) Edq.

title: Electric Field Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should derive the electric field E at the surface of the sphere correctly as E = Q/(4πε0r^2).

title: Surface Charge Density
description: Important Criteria: The student must define the surface charge density σ = Q/(4πr^2) accurately.

title: Direction of Force
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain that the force on the charge element dq is radial and outward.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the derivation.

title: Common Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as incorrect signs in the force expression or electric field.
